guard.summary:
The render guard is in Draft PR #34 (https://github.com/kco994553-star/Investment-System1/pull/34). Branch integration/web/research-render-guard-v1 @ 2b53b27fe0f570557159d02552911e9e1cc7be9c, based on feature/producer-infrastructure-v1 @ f8af596df4d235fee1f29bf0cb6c9a3cc0f89f36. Two commits: 1e90886 (the guard, tests and workflow) and 2b53b27 (a fix to the optional before/after comparison in the browser test).

What changed: app.js now checks each section when data.json loads. A section in LIVE or FROZEN_SNAPSHOT that carries a research marker is shown in the existing NOT_AVAILABLE presentation, with a ko/en reason and the marker path and status. Its values never reach the page. The served data.json is not rewritten. If the universe section is withheld, the companies legend and the search rows stop showing FROZEN_SNAPSHOT. locale.js gains one UI string.

The guard copies producers/contract.py @ f8af596 exactly: SECTION_NAMES (L23), PUBLISHED_STATES (L26), RESEARCH_STATUSES (L28-30) and the rejection rule (L197-202). It reads the status where the assembler writes it: <section>.producer.methodology.status (assembler.py L31, L47). It also checks research_state.status against the same set. The contract itself does not check research_state.

product/web_mvp.py, producers/* and Track C paths are untouched. No schema-1 state, grant or DISPLAY_RESEARCH is added, and nothing is recomputed.

New files:
- implementation/tests/test_web_research_guard.py (4 tests)
- implementation/tools/build_web_research_guard_fixture.py
- implementation/tools/web_research_guard_browser_test.js
- .github/workflows/web-research-guard.yml

GitHub Actions on the PR head 2b53b27 both succeeded: web-research-guard (run 37109567406) and web-mvp-validation (run 37109567361).

Local runs used Playwright 1.56.1 with Chromium 141, not the 1.58.2 the workflows pin; CI did run 1.58.2. The worktrees are removed and pruned and the local branch ref is deleted; the branch stays on origin. /tmp/rig-news-producer-ro was created by another session after my run started, so I left it. Evidence and logs are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Investment-System1/33fa0ec1-e143-560f-87b9-563dee3b3dc5/scratchpad/wf5/web-guard/.

Branch state: pushed. Integration: merges cleanly into all four downstream branches; tests pass locally on the merged #30 tree. Canonical: not merged.

criteria.criterion: Determine exactly which research markers the producer contract rejects for LIVE/FROZEN_SNAPSHOT, and where producer metadata sits in the bundle
criteria.evidence: producers/contract.py @ f8af596: L197-202 rejects a section in PUBLISHED_STATES ('LIVE','FROZEN_SNAPSHOT', L26) when methodology.status is in RESEARCH_STATUSES (L28-30). That set is {PROVISIONAL_RESEARCH, IDEA, RESEARCH, PROVISIONAL, PROVISIONAL_INITIAL_PRIOR}, built from enums.py L33-43. SECTION_NAMES is L23. The assembler writes producer metadata at <section>.producer, built by _meta (L26-34; methodology at L31) and attached at L47, so the status sits at <section>.producer.methodology.status. producer_manifest.sections has no methodology field. research_state: the contract does not reject on it and the assembler never writes it into a section. On #17, publication/extractors.py (L52-55, L92-95) copies research_state.status as methodology_lifecycle, and predicate.py L63 compares it to the same RESEARCH_STATUSES. On #30, leaderboard_producer/infra_boundary.py L88/L149 maps it to methodology.status. P01 publication_envelope (#17 envelope.py): a top-level key whose decisions are keyed by subject_sha256 and always schema1_data_state=NOT_AVAILABLE. It has no per-section lifecycle field, so the guard does not read it. No new status values were added; the pytest pins the app.js constants to the contract.

The new branch integration/web/production-state-presentation-v1 is at e91dc773af600ff66d31575ce3774490a0b0be8c, one commit on top of the base.

**What changed.** The change is presentation-only and touches five web_assets files (app.js, locale.js, style.css, index.html, network-bridge.js), plus new test files and one new workflow.
- **Freshness:** freshness is now its own badge (FRESH, STALE or NOT_USABLE), each with its own style rule. STALE is no longer a suffix inside the LIVE badge.
- **Metadata:** unavailable sections show the producer metadata the bundle already stores, and only when it is present.
- **Strings:** the listed hard-coded strings now have Korean and English entries.

Base origin/feature/producer-infrastructure-v1 @ f8af596df4d235fee1f29bf0cb6c9a3cc0f89f36, which is also the merge-base. Draft PR #34 is open, not merged, base feature/producer-infrastructure-v1, head 2b53b27. I re-fetched after the review and the SHAs had not changed.
nonblocking: N1 (bypass, same in the contract): if the status is spelled differently, the section still renders under the published badge. Bundles V01 'provisional_research', V02 'Provisional_Research' and V03 ' PROVISIONAL_RESEARCH' (all LIVE), and V09 'provisional' (FROZEN_SNAPSHOT), show the probe 11.11 under the LIVE or FROZEN_SNAPSHOT badge on home and company/nvda. web_mvp.validate_bundle accepts all four. producers/contract.validate_snapshot also accepts them, because it matches the status exactly and is case-sensitive. So the guard matches the contract exactly, and the gap sits in the contract itself. Real producers on #30 only emit the uppercase constants. Suggested fix: make both the contract and the guard accept only exact known status values (allowlist), or normalize the status first. That is a contract change and is owner-scoped.

N2 (bypass, outside the assembler path): a research status in a non-assembler location is not checked. V05 puts methodology.status=PROVISIONAL_RESEARCH at the section top level with no producer object; the same snapshot fails the contract with ResearchStatusError. V07 puts producer.methodology.status=PROVISIONAL_RESEARCH inside data.nvda. V06 uses flat keys producer.status and methodology_status. V17 uses methodology_lifecycle or lifecycle inside a data row. All four render 11.11 under LIVE. The checks are uneven: research_state.status is searched anywhere in the section, but producer.methodology.status is only read at the top. Hardening options: search methodology.status at any depth too, or withhold any LIVE section that has no producer.methodology.status (legacy FROZEN universe and DEMO excepted). The second option is a policy choice for the owner.

N3 (bypass, top-level only): a research marker that appears only in publication_envelope or producer_manifest (V04) does not stop a LIVE section from rendering. This is the documented design. On #17 the envelope is keyed by subject_sha256, not by section, and the contract never reads it.

N4 (parity gap, other rule in the same lines): the guard does not copy the validation half of contract L197-202. L198-199 reject LIVE or FROZEN_SNAPSHOT unless validation.status is PASS. V11 (LIVE, methodology VALIDATED, producer.validation.status=FAIL) renders under LIVE, while the contract rejects it with ValidationStatusError. V10 (status given as an array) also renders, while the contract rejects it with MissingFieldError. Commit 1e90886 says it mirrors 'the L197-202 rejection rule', which overstates it: only L200-202 are mirrored. The PR body's description of the rule is accurate, but the line range should read L200-202.

N5 (stricter than the contract, documented): the deep research_state.status check can withhold a section the contract would accept. An example is a LIVE section whose methodology status is not a research status but whose rows carry research_state PROVISIONAL_RESEARCH. This can only withhold, never display, and the PR body lists it as a reviewer decision point. So the guard is not literally 'exact' in that direction.

N6 (test strength): with app.js reverted to the f8af596 version (sha256 7944757a...3dbead9), only 2 of the 4 new pytest tests fail: the constants mirror and the localized reason. test_fixture_methodology_markers_are_exactly_what_the_producer_contract_rejects and test_fixture_build_is_presentation_only still pass, because they test the fixture, not the guard. The browser E2E does fail on revert, with 'ko-KR home leaked 11.11', so overall the guard is covered.

N7 (scope note): besides the Web assets (app.js, and locale.js, which holds the i18n strings) and the new tests and tools, the branch adds a CI workflow, .github/workflows/web-research-guard.yml (read-only permissions, test vectors). It is in the spirit of 'new tests/tools', but it is outside the strict list. style.css, index.html and network-bridge.js are unchanged.

N8 (not changed here, known): DEMO sections with research markers are not guarded, and neither is the top-level companies list (market_cap_rank). Both are disclosed in the PR body. The other G3-area gaps from GIE-006 §4 remain open: STALE badge styling, FRESH label, index.html loading text, hard-coded strings, and uncaught errors after hashchange.

blocking: The new U1 freshness code shows a FRESH label on expired data. The bug is in app.js freshnessOf(): `return persisted==="FRESH" || expires>now?"FRESH":null;`. When Date.parse(s.expires_at) returns NaN, this line trusts the freshness=FRESH that the assembler saved when it built the bundle. producers/contract.parse_ts and the unchanged web_mvp.validate_bundle both use Python datetime.fromisoformat, which accepts ISO-8601 forms that JS Date.parse rejects with NaN. Three such forms were checked in node and python3: basic "20260103T000000Z", week date "2026-W01-6T00:00:00+00:00" and comma fraction "...T00:00:00,5+00:00". I reproduced it through the real producer path with no hand-edited metadata. I took the branch fixture's `changes` LIVE snapshot and changed only expires_at to "20260103T000000Z". assembler.assemble_bundle at 2026-01-02 saved freshness=FRESH, and the schema-1 validator accepted the bundle. In Chromium with the clock at 2026-10-03, nine months after expiry, the branch renders badges ["LIVE","FRESH · 만료 전"], meaning 'Before expiry'. Base 2b53b27 renders ["LIVE"]. This contradicts the PR's stated rule that a LIVE section past expires_at is STALE, and freshness.py's 'never silently current'. The page affirmatively labels expired data as current. Fix: when expires_at cannot be parsed, never return FRESH (fail closed to STALE or show no badge), and add a test for that case.
nonblocking: (1) Scope: DONE. `git diff --name-status 2b53b27 e91dc77` lists 9 paths. Added: .github/workflows/web-state-presentation.yml, tests/test_web_state_presentation.py, tools/build_web_state_presentation_fixture.py and tools/web_state_presentation_browser_test.js. Modified: web_assets/app.js, index.html, locale.js, network-bridge.js and style.css. Nothing under implementation/src changed outside product/web_assets. product/web_mvp.py has the same blob 10ad8c7624a0a31e602be699144cbcb534c96e53 at base and head. No Track C paths changed (grep for evl/, test_evl_c, evl_c8, track_c_ found none). `git branch -r --contains e91dc77` returns only origin/integration/web/production-state-presentation-v1, so no codex/* or owner branch has the commit. The new CI workflow file is test infrastructure, so I accept it.

(2) Guard bypass bundles: the G3 guard is unchanged from the base, and its decisions are identical on base and branch. I ran 17 crafted bundles, all accepted by validate_bundle, in Chromium on the branch build and on a copy with base assets. Results: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Investment-System1/33fa0ec1-e143-560f-87b9-563dee3b3dc5/scratchpad/wf5/review-pspv1-run/bypass/{branch,base}-results.json. Withheld on both, as expected: the LIVE + PROVISIONAL_RESEARCH control, FROZEN + PROVISIONAL_RESEARCH, and FROZEN + research_state RESEARCH. Probe value 11.11 renders on both under LIVE for: lowercase, mixed-case and trailing-space status; 'research'; a marker only in publication_envelope; a marker only in producer_manifest.sections.qgv; producer missing with methodology at section level; data row status (not research_state); methodology.lifecycle with no status; and status given as an array. It also renders under FROZEN_SNAPSHOT for lowercase research_state.status, and under DEMO with a research status, which is by design. The case variants match the producer contract exactly: validate_snapshot also accepts 'provisional_research', 'Provisional_Research', 'PROVISIONAL_RESEARCH ' and 'research' as LIVE. The missing-status and array-status cases are ones the contract would reject but the Web renders. These gaps already exist on base (they belong to the web_mvp.py validator-hardening follow-up), so they are not a regression from this PR. One cosmetic amplification: the branch now adds a 'FRESH · Before expiry' badge next to LIVE on these bypassed research sections.

New display channel (U2, under NOT_AVAILABLE, not LIVE/FROZEN): producerMeta() now shows arbitrary persisted strings for NOT_AVAILABLE sections whose methodology status is research. The fields are reason_code, producer as_of and methodology id/version, plus any integer validation.*_count or coverage_counts. My bypass bundle B14 had qgv with status PROVISIONAL_RESEARCH, reason_code 'QGV_TOTAL_SCORE_11.11' and coverage_counts {nvda_total_score_x100:1111}. The branch rendered all of it in the main view; base rendered none of it. This is by design (the PR fixture itself shows COMPLETE=3, NONE=1, PARTIAL=1 for a RESEARCH_DISPLAY_GRANT_NONE qgv), but the `*_count` suffix filter is permissive. Recommend an allowlist of count keys.

(3) No recomputation and no new state: DONE, by code read and test. Diff additions are limited to: string equality against the FRESHNESS constant; selection of the more restrictive of two stored freshness copies; joining stored integers with no arithmetic; and the existing expires_at vs Date.now() comparison. No score, rank, regime, zone or portfolio value is computed. The U2 browser check asserts every non-withheld D[section] deep-equals the served section, and data.json bytes are unchanged. STATES is still {LIVE, FROZEN_SNAPSHOT, DEMO, NOT_AVAILABLE}, and DISPLAY_RESEARCH is absent from app.js. There is one new fail-closed presentation rule: a section other than NOT_AVAILABLE with a stored NOT_USABLE, from producer.freshness or producer_manifest alone, is shown as NOT_AVAILABLE. This applies to DEMO and FROZEN as well. It is acceptable, but note it as a new view rule.
